title: The Map in the Pit
lines: The fan is at the map.
Tip! The map is in the pit!
Tim, tip the map at Sam.
Fan it, Pam! Fan Sam. Fan Tim!

questions.ask: What made the map tip into the pit?
questions.listenFor: The fan, blowing on it. Lines four and five say it. Let your child read them again instead of you giving the answer.

questions.ask: Who got the map back out?
questions.listenFor: Tim. He was sitting at the pit. If your child says Sam, ask them who the map got tipped to, and who did the tipping.

questions.ask: Where would you keep the map so it stays safe? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any place is fine. You are listening for a reason that shows they understood the fan was the problem, like away from the fan.
